scope_note: Source-aware provisional review of all 40 completed bundle-6 records against frozen per-snapshot expectations and exact supplied passages. These constructed controls change whitespace only, not substantive wording. They do not establish broad wording/paraphrase robustness. No inference, human judgments, or independent reference labels were created.
assessment_policy: Read actual full answers, expectations and retrieved passages; distinguish factual correctness from supplied support and citation/version compatibility. Unsupported extra claims can fail an otherwise correct opening. Incomplete or internally contradictory answers remain unresolved where semantic rubric application is uncertain. These annotations are AI-assisted proposals, excluded from official human accuracy and testing-tool precision/recall.

findings: The 10 pass, 27 fail and 3 unresolved outcomes are provisional agent proposals over 40 records, not human benchmark accuracy.

Factory declaration-order answers permit later-field dependencies although that limitation was absent from actual retrieved context; alternative-name answers similarly lack the needed AliasChoices evidence.
AliasPath outputs repeat the whole input, separate-generator answers substitute per-field serialization aliases, and several priority/strictness answers contradict supplied rules.

All four partial-JSON-defaults answers invent explicit_version; this token is application target metadata, not the supplied Pydantic recommendation. Its reuse does not prove cause or answer-key leakage.
The three unresolved answers comprise one wrong-polarity strictness opening with a correct body and two partial-JSON answers that omit the concrete recovered prefix.

Before/after differences here are observations under whitespace-only corpus controls. Changed snapshot/chunk identifiers and unmeasured model variability preclude attributing differences solely to whitespace; broad wording robustness is not measured.
All cited IDs were checked to exist in actual supplied passages and have requested 2.10.6 scope; semantic relevance/support is assessed separately.
